fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM174,350. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0003088/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: STPM/Matriculation/Pre-University/Equivalent: GPA 2.33 in two of the following subjects: Biology, Physics/Mathematics, Chemistry; MUET Band 3 or IELTS 5.5/TOEFL 550 for foreign candidates. A-Level or Equivalent: Grade D in two of the following subjects: Biology, Physics/Mathematics, Chemistry; MUET Band 3 or IELTS 5.5/TOEFL 550 for foreign candidates. Diploma (related field): Minimum CGPA 2.75; CGPA below 2.75 must have at least 3 years of working experience in related field; MUET Band 3 or IELTS 5.5/TOEFL 550 for foreign candidates.
